entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon and former planeswalker who narrates, buried alive by Nissa, who frees himself and uses the Zendikari's hedron trap to regain his spark.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker of the Joraga who took Khalni Heart from Ob Nixilis and buried him under rock.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who created the hedron network and took Ob Nixilis's spark, whom he loathes and admires; he assumes she is dead.

entities.name: Kalitas
entities.description: A vampire who learned the hard way that the Eldrazi work through allies.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that has stripped Bala Ged of life and is now trapped in the hedron network at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose lone spawn float in the skies.

entities.name: Zendikari army
entities.description: The armies and refugees making the last stand of Zendikar at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Kor sentries
entities.description: Kor lookouts and kitesailers defending Sea Gate.

entities.name: Khalni Heart
entities.description: A relocated source of raw mana of Zendikar that Ob Nixilis seized and Nissa took from him.

entities.name: Hedron network
entities.description: The network of hedrons that Ob Nixilis built with a keystone and that the Zendikari reproduced on a vast scale around Ulamog.

entities.name: Hedron trap
entities.description: The huge ring of structural hedrons at Sea Gate holding Ulamog, whose energy Ob Nixilis taps.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane being destroyed by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A continent of Zendikar stripped of all life by Ulamog, where Ob Nixilis was buried.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: The continent where Sea Gate lies and where the last stand takes place.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city where the Zendikari make their last stand against Ulamog.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: The event decades ago that changed what being a planeswalker means and left many planes without protectors.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The collection of planes that Ob Nixilis once traveled.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis wakes buried alive after Nissa took Khalni Heart and collapsed the cavern on him.
Ob Nixilis recalls his failed plan to synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart and reignite his spark.
events.quote: Synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart, and use it to channel enough planar energy through my body to reignite my spark.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis weighs his options and decides he must save Zendikar to buy time to rebuild his work.
events.quote: I was going to have to save Zendikar.

events.summary: He digs himself out over days, finding Bala Ged stripped of life so there is nothing to drain.
events.quote: The entire process of escape took days.

events.summary: He recovers the keystone hedron of his network and uses it to sense where the last stand will be.
events.quote: Sea Gate, if memory served. A lovely place for a slaughter.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis flies to Tazeem and Sea Gate.
At Sea Gate he sees Ulamog trapped in an enormous hedron network.
events.quote: Armies clashing, spawn and Zendikari slaughtered by the thousands, and rising above it all, Ulamog. Trapped.

events.summary: He flies above the battle and locks his keystone hedron above the ring's center, tapping the network's energy.
events.quote: I willed it into place, locked it into a harmonic point above the ring's precise center.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis's spark returns and he feels the Multiverse again.
He knocks a structural hedron out of alignment, freeing Ulamog and collapsing the network, and Nissa sees him.
events.quote: A snap of my fingers, and one of the structural hedrons fell out of alignment.

events.summary: He unleashes a bolt of annihilation on the armies, cutting off their retreat and forcing them toward Ulamog.
events.quote: I let loose an enormous bolt of withering annihilation into the armies below

events.summary: Ob Nixilis reaches out to an awakening power deep beneath the surface to the south and calls it to rise.
events.quote: Awakened it fully with the sheer force of my will.

relations.note: Ob Nixilis wants to end the elf who buried him.
relations.quote: I imagined a thousand pleasing ways to end the elf's miserable existence.

relations.note: Ob Nixilis loathes Nahiri while admiring her work.
relations.quote: There was room in my loathing of Nahiri to admire her genius.

relations.note: Nissa took Khalni Heart and buried him.
relations.quote: Nissa took Khalni Heart from the demon would-be Planeswalker

relations.note: He seized its power, then Nissa took it from him.
relations.quote: He'd seized the power of the relocated Khalni Heart

relations.note: He built his own hedron network over decades.
relations.quote: It was the keystone in the hedron network I had created

relations.note: Ulamog is trapped within the ring when Ob Nixilis arrives.
